query: For my 56-year-old female patient: what is the interquartile range of in-hospital mortality per encounter among women aged 51–61?
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY mortality_duration) - percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY mortality_duration) AS interquartile_range FROM mortality_data;
